facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of Thalia Mara Hall, the Russell C. Davis Planetarium and the Hinds County Courthouse.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel is within walking distance of Thalia Mara Hall, Jackson's historic music and arts theatre, as well as other attractions like the Russell C. Davis Planetarium and the Hinds County Courthouse.

facts.text: The Mississippi Coliseum is about one mile from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Located just one mile away from our contemporary hotel, The Mississippi Coliseum is home to concerts, special events, sporting events and more.

facts.text: The Music Legends of Mississippi package lets guests play exact replica guitars of six pioneers of American music in their room.
facts.excerpt: showcasing exact replica guitars from six legendary pioneers of American Music. Guests are invited to play one of these legendary replicas in the comfort of their own guest room when they book our Music Legends of Mississippi package.

facts.text: The Westin Heavenly Bed has 10 layers of bedding.
facts.excerpt: sink into our signature Westin Heavenly® Bed that envelops you in 10 layers of blissful bedding

facts.text: All rooms have Westin Heavenly Bath White Tea bath and body products.
facts.excerpt: Refresh the senses with Westin Heavenly Bath® White Tea Bath & Body products in all rooms

facts.text: Suites have separate living and sleeping areas.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your stay in our hotel suites in Jackson, MS with separate living and sleeping areas
Enjoy the convenience of 24-hour room service

facts.text: Soul Spa is a day spa offering massages, facials and other treatments.
facts.excerpt: Soul Spa is a restorative day spa in downtown Jackson, MS, offering massages, facials and rejuvenating treatments

facts.text: Soul Spa has separate men's and women's lounges.
The hotel has an indoor saltwater pool.
facts.excerpt: Hotel guests are invited to lounge by our indoor Saltwater Pool.

facts.text: The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio is open 24/7.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your workout at our 24/7 WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio.

facts.text: Guests can explore Jackson on the hotel's custom cruiser bicycles.
facts.excerpt: Bicycle TourExplore Jackson on wheels with our custom cruisers.

facts.text: Estelle Southern Table serves modern Southern cuisine for breakfast, lunch, dinner and weekend brunch.
facts.excerpt: Estelle Southern Table brings modern Southern dining to downtown Jackson, Mississippi with locally inspired cuisine, handcrafted cocktails and warm hospitality. Located inside The Westin Jackson, Estelle serves breakfast, lunch, dinner and weekend brunch.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Only dogs up to 40 pounds are allowed, in a limited selection of pet-friendly rooms.
facts.excerpt: We offer a limited selection of pet-friendly guest rooms, and guests are welcome to bring a dog weighing up to 40 pounds. No other pets are permitted.
